name: ME Dubai
insider_take: Where futuristic design meets Dubai's electric energy in the heart of The Opus
whats_special: ME Dubai occupies the stunning cube-shaped Opus building designed by Zaha Hadid - her only completed project in the Middle East. The hotel features an infinity pool that appears to float in mid-air and offers 360-degree views of Dubai's skyline from the 77th-floor rooftop.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cocktail at the rooftop bar Level 77 - it's one of the highest outdoor terraces in Dubai and offers unparalleled views of the Burj Khalifa and Downtown skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's dramatic void that cuts through the building's center creates an optical illusion best viewed from Sheikh Zayed Road. Inside, experience the immersive digital art installations and dine at the award-winning ROKA restaurant for contemporary Japanese robatayaki cuisine.
pros: Striking contemporary design with avant-garde architecture
Prime location on The Beach at JBR with direct beach access
Multiple innovative dining venues and rooftop experiences
Vibrant nightlife scene with exclusive beach clubs
cons: Party-focused atmosphere may not suit all travelers
Higher price point for premium beachfront location
